summary: Example step using rhaap:create-project with the AAP token, deleteIfExist true, project name and organization from parameters, a GitHub scmUrl, branch main, scmUpdateOnLaunch true and a GitHub Token credential.
questions: Show an example of rhaap:create-project in a template
How do I set the SCM branch in rhaap:create-project?
How do I pass the AAP token to a Backstage action?

answer_card.title: rhaap:create-project example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
steps:
  - id: create-aap-project
    name: Create AAP Project
    action: rhaap:create-project
    input:
      token: ${{ parameters.AAP_TOKEN }}
      deleteIfExist: true
      values:
        projectName: ${{ parameters.projectName }}
        organization: ${{ parameters.organization }}
        scmUrl: https://github.com/my-org/ansible-playbooks
        scmBranch: main
        scmUpdateOnLaunch: true
        credentials: GitHub Token
```
